scope: bounded synthetic existing-Bot model editor; no Gradle rerun during publication

citation_gate.note: Diff-driven gate; not a claim that every prose reference is independently attributable.

privacy: Allowlisted unchanged synthetic PNGs, safe JSON receipts and observed traces, curated report and reconstructible sources/patches only; no APK, raw execution logs, archives, serials, private host paths or AppleDouble files.
source_diff_check: Reconstructed pre-publication snapshot matches all nine current source/test/harness files; publication edits are documentation/evidence only.
whitespace_check: Source/docs checked; hash-significant archived patch files excluded.
